record.question: Which one is declared as India’s first World Heritage City?
record.explanation: UNESCO's State Party conservation report explicitly identifies Ahmadabad as the first Indian city to receive this recognition in July 2017. Historical exam context: 2018 (year only; no day/month printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://whc.unesco.org/document/180057 ; https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1551/ Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
